purpose: Independently implement a first-place-v42-derived supervised sequence encoder, add its top-200 order candidates to the established 400, and fit one neural-aware order ranker against the actual established reference pipeline.
adaptations: One deterministic uniform cut per eligible historical session per epoch rather than every possible event anchor.
Use only history strictly before the ranker fitting period, not validation prefixes or held-out targets.
Use cyclic 168-hour embeddings with adjacent-hour smoothing instead of absolute dataset-hour IDs, to permit genuine temporal extrapolation.
Mask padding and every positive-negative identity collision; evaluate the contrastive loss with logsumexp.
Use BF16 dense matrix operations where supported, FP32 embeddings and loss; record realized versions and hashes.
Train one encoder rather than the winner's eight-member candidate ensemble.
Keep every original candidate and append novel neural top-200 items; never replace original candidates.
Fit one fixed order ranker; preserve established click/cart fusion. No parameter search or evaluation-selected recipe.
